scripts.apply:local: npm run install:both && npm run install:desktop
scripts.test:unit: vitest run apps/vscode-extension/src packages/markdown-core/src packages/editor-core/src packages/contracts/tests packages/editor-sync/tests packages/preview-ui/tests packages/node-runtime/tests apps/desktop/src/main/**/*.test.ts
scripts.lint: oxlint apps/vscode-extension/src packages/markdown-core/src packages/editor-core/src packages/contracts/src packages/editor-sync packages/preview-ui/src packages/node-runtime/src apps/desktop/src
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @easyview/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @easyview/editor-sync && npm run typecheck --workspace @easyview/markdown-core && npm run typecheck --workspace @easyview/editor-core && npm run typecheck --workspace @easyview/preview-ui && npm run typecheck --workspace @easyview/node-runtime && npm run typecheck --workspace easyview-md && npm run typecheck --workspace @easyview/desktop
scripts.verify:quick: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run check:architecture && npm run verify:brand && npm run check:editor-cycles && npm run build && npm run test:unit
scripts.verify:vscode: npm run build && npm run test:e2e && npm run package:vscode && npm run verify:vscode-package
scripts.verify:desktop: npm run typecheck --workspace @easyview/desktop && vitest run apps/desktop/src && npm run build:desktop
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify:quick && npm run test:e2e:pw && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:desktop && npm run package:vscode && npm run package:desktop
